Firing range of initiation zones

Source: R/izones.R
calculate_firing_range.Rd

For each IZ with at least min_rep_tracks assigned tracks, the earliest firing time is the smallest rep_percent among cells with a track assigned to the IZ, and the latest unreplicated time is the largest rep_percent among cells whose unreplicated segment (run of bins in state unrep_state) covers the IZ centre, using only the segments that cover the fewest IZ centres. Each bound is corroborated when the second-best value is within 0.1 of it. IZs with latest_unrep_percent < earliest_rep_percent get NA bounds and corroborated = FALSE.

Usage

calculate_firing_range(
  gr_izones,
  genobins_rep_states,
  replication_tracks,
  unrep_state = 2,
  min_rep_tracks = 2,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

gr_izones

GRanges of IZs with an n_tracks column (e.g. define_initiation_zones()$izones); IZ i must have iz_id == i.

genobins_rep_states

Matrix of states, bins x cells, with row names "chr-start-end" and cell IDs as column names; every IZ centre must lie in exactly one bin.

replication_tracks

CompressedGRangesList of tracks with metadata columns iz_id, cell_id and rep_percent (e.g. define_initiation_zones()$tracks); every matrix column must have a rep_percent.

unrep_state

State of unreplicated bins.

min_rep_tracks

Minimum n_tracks of an IZ.

verbose

Logical; print progress messages. Default FALSE.

Value

gr_izones with columns earliest_rep_percent, latest_unrep_percent and corroborated.
